name: Asset Alchemist
title: Web Cinema Embed First — Persistent Player Sources
subtitle: Web Cinema Embed First — Persistent Player Sources
features: Brought back the original PROXIMUS Embed First experience inside the existing compact Web Cinema Gateway, accepting official iframe embed snippets or player URLs without executing arbitrary HTML
Added user-selectable playback routing: automatic detection, official embedded player, native browser video source, or standard website preview, with the more technical controls collapsed by default
Allowed browser-supported direct media streams and signed HTTPS video URLs even when the URL does not end in a conventional video file extension, subject to hosting permissions and actual media data

Remembered the chosen official player address or native source on each saved watch-later entry, while preserving the original full watch URL, titles, collections, favorites, and previously saved progress
Kept manual JSON link import/export and metadata-only Recovery Center/Workspace Sync backups compatible with earlier Web Cinema collections without a destructive migration
Displayed safer link previews by masking sensitive access tokens in the library while retaining the real full URLs in browser storage and playback requests
Maintained strict external URL validation and sandboxing; no arbitrary embed HTML execution, proxying, login bypass, site protection evasion, streaming-site scraping, or video downloading

Preserved existing ORBIT responsive PC/iPhone interface, opaque Video Vault, saved music and Play on Start, Mobile Power Guard, all companion studios, rollback history, and direct GitHub-to-Discord release workflow
